newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Treasury sees solid housing recovery.
newsitem.headline: Australian Treasury sees solid housing recovery.

text.p: Australian Treasury senior forecaster Martin Parkinson said on Monday he expected a substantial recovery in the housing market over the next 12 months.
"We're reasonably confident that you'll see a fairly solid housing recovery over the next 12 months," Parkinson told a Senate committee.
"That's a view that I think is pretty widely shared by the industry."
In its May 13 budget, the Treasury forecast 11 percent growth in housing expenditure, after adjustment for inflation, in the 1997/98 fiscal year.
The forecast compared with a two percent fall in 1996/97.
